main.description: Lists the members currently banned from a community. Being banned means the community declines to issue them space credentials, so they cannot read it. Their existing messages stay in their own repos.

community.description: The community to list bans for.

limit.description: Maximum number of bans to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
Pagination cursor for the next page, if more bans exist.

bans.description: Members currently banned, most recently banned first.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the member.ban permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.
